title: Explore mode
intro: The api service was OOM-killed twice last week. Before it happens again, use Explore to find which pod is using the most memory right now.

objectives.text: Find the pod with the highest memory usage
objectives.question: Which pod uses the most memory right now?

hints: In Explore, query memory_bytes and look at the table below the graph.
Want only the top pod? Try topk(1, memory_bytes).
solution: topk(1, memory_bytes) returns api-2, whose memory has climbed steadily for 5 hours (a leak).
debrief: Explore is Grafana's scratchpad for ad-hoc questions, with no dashboard needed. A line that climbs steadily and never drops is the classic sign of a memory leak. topk() is a handy way to pull out the worst offender.
